senses.def: A slide valve with a cup-like cavity in its face, through which exhaust steam passes.
A sermon upon the weekly parashah.
In a sterilization procedure, the amount of time required, at a given condition, to kill 90% of relevant microorganisms.
The third of four stages of development that the world goes through as part of the cycle of yugas; it lasts for 864,000 years.

A copulative or coordinative type of compound in which members, if not compounded, would be in the same case and connected by the conjunction and. Common in languages such as Sanskrit, Chinese and Japanese, but less so in English.
